# 💩 UselessOS™ Code of Cursed Conduct

## 1. Our Pledge
In the interest of fostering an environment of unbridled software chaos, we as contributors and maintainers pledge to make participating in UselessOS an experience free of linters, free of clean architecture, and free of sensible engineering patterns.

We commit to welcoming everyone who wants to write the worst code of their lives.

---

## 2. Our Standards

### ✅ Required Behaviors
- **Writing 15 lines where 1 line would suffice.**
- **Using variable names that cause existential confusion.**
- **Ensuring 100% test pass rate despite terrifying implementations.**
- **Embracing Windows 95, GeoCities, neon cyan, and Comic Sans.**
- **Confessing your coding sins in PR descriptions.**

### ❌ Unacceptable Behaviors
- Submitting pull requests with conventional commit tags (`feat:`, `fix:`).
- Sneaking semicolons (`;`) into code files.
- Refactoring someone's O(N^3) manual lookup into an O(1) dictionary.
- Shaming someone because their code is inefficient. **Inefficiency is our core metric.**
- Asking if this project solves any real-world problem.

---

## 3. Enforcement
Violations of clean code are celebrated.  
Violations of cursed standards (e.g. attempting to optimize code) will result in immediate PR rejection by our automated bots.

---

## 4. Real Software Relief
If you suffer from actual software trauma and require real, professional agency engineering:  
Please seek refuge at **[euton.co](https://euton.co)**.
